findings.title: R10_VALIDATION section 8 still gives the wall-allowance wire room as 4.503 mm; the correct figure is 4.493 mm
findings.contradicts: Correct calculation sqrt(24.9^2 - 5^2) - |3.40 - 23| - 0.3 = 4.4928 mm; docs/M3_R10.md line 860 ('4.493 mm (R23-MECHANICS-01 correction; 4.503 mm was stated before)'), docs/ORDERING.md 8.4 'All terminal leads' row (4.493 mm), R10_VALIDATION owner row 31 ('4.493 mm (was quoted 4.503)') and R10_VALIDATION line 1915 (R23-MECHANICS-01 recorded as fixed to 4.493 mm)
findings.evidence: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2752 at 3d8e845, under '## R10 deviations for owner acceptance' > '### 8. Mechanics, access and retention': 'Wire room (5.003 mm) is measured to the nominal Ø 50.8 mm bore wall at 5 mm height without the 0.5 mm wall allowance (4.503 mm with it)'. The wire faces are at x = 3.40 / 42.60 on board 92c3ad59 (fit_check --profile r10 rows J1/J121/J400/J440 x 3.40..11.50, J9/J122/J410/J420 x 34.50..42.60). Radius 24.9 mm: 24.3929 - 19.6 - 0.3 = 4.4928 mm; 4.503 mm is 5.003 - 0.5 (subtracting the allowance instead of recomputing), the exact slip that R23-MECHANICS-01 corrected in M3_R10. The paragraph is maintained as current (line 2751 next to it carries the R24-TRI-09 figures).
findings.impact: The owner-acceptance list states a wire-room figure 0.010 mm larger than the calculation and contradicts row 31 and M3_R10 in the same records; the 20-22 AWG bend arithmetic is unaffected.
findings.concrete_fix: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2752: '(4.503 mm with it)' -> '(4.493 mm with it; R23-MECHANICS-01)'. Docs only.
